title: What Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Fully homomorphic encryption lets you compute on encrypted data without decrypting it: a server can run a program on ciphertexts and return an encrypted result only you can read. The server learns nothing about the data or the result. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE): start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) in one line: Fully homomorphic encryption lets you compute on encrypted data without decrypting it: a server can run a program on ciphertexts and return an encrypted result only you can read.
Why it matters: It solves cloud privacy at the root: use any untrusted server without exposing your data..
Where it is used: private medical analysis, confidential finance, private AI inference, secure voting tallies..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
